title: Vice-Chair, Subsidiary Body for Science and Technological Advice (UNFCCC), Advisor for Nature-Based Solutions (Dominican Republic)
bio: Carol Franco is an ecological economist with over 25 years of experience advancing climate policy, food security, and nature-based solutions through research and international collaboration.
